steps.label: UAT-7.1: the bar stacks TWO rows - progress+time sit BELOW the transport, and the title recovers real width
UAT-7.2: transport glyphs sized up - SVG era (v328-2): each step/pp button renders an svg glyph with a real box >= 15px (font-size retired with the text glyphs)
UAT-7.3: the key filter lists CHROMATICALLY from C, majors then minors (no more fifths jumble)
steps.js: (function(){var R={C:0,'C#':1,Db:1,D:2,'D#':3,Eb:3,E:4,F:5,'F#':6,Gb:6,G:7,'G#':8,Ab:8,A:9,'A#':10,Bb:10,B:11};var opts=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#keySel option')).map(function(o){return o.value;}).filter(function(v){return v!=='all';});if(opts.length<3)return false;var last=-1;for(var i=0;i<opts.length;i++){var m=/m$/.test(opts[i]);var root=m?opts[i].slice(0,-1):opts[i];if(!(root in R))return false;var rank=(m?100:0)+R[root];if(rank<last)return false;last=rank;}return true;})()

steps.label: UAT-7.4: a synthesized EMBED-PAUSE (state 2) syncs the honest UI - bar flips to play, eq freezes (the return-from-background fix)
UAT-7.4b: npPaused set, pp shows play, the row equalizer froze
steps.js: (function(){var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('npPaused'))return false;var pp=p.querySelector('[data-nppp]');var row=document.querySelector('[data-npkey="reggae backing track in a major|petti music studios|A|major"]');return !!pp&&pp.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Play'&&!!row&&row.classList.contains('isPaused');})()

steps.label: UAT-7.4c: a synthesized RESUME (state 1) syncs back to playing
UAT-7.4d: playing again - npPaused off, row eq animating
steps.js: (function(){var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(p.classList.contains('npPaused'))return false;var row=document.querySelector('[data-npkey="reggae backing track in a major|petti music studios|A|major"]');return !!row&&row.classList.contains('isPlaying')&&!row.classList.contains('isPaused');})()

steps.label: UAT-7.5: Media Session carries the track metadata and a live playbackState
steps.js: (function(){if(!('mediaSession' in navigator))return true;var md=navigator.mediaSession.metadata;return !!md&&md.title==='Reggae Backing Track in A Major'&&navigator.mediaSession.playbackState==='playing';})()
